content:
Sam: Dropping a quick UX pass for the routing policies editor. Need feedback on ordering, validation text, and the preview trace.
Anika: Uploaded small Figma update: https://figma.com/file/def. Focus: priority handle size, validation copy, preview panel.
Maya: Handle is tiny on touch. Make it at least 32px high.
Jon: We'll optimistic-update reorder client-side and PATCH order; revert on conflict.
Sam: Validation approach: ERROR blocks save, WARNING allows save with a confirmation, INFO just shows in inspector.
Liam: Backend returns diagnostics array with severity and trace tokens we can render.
Anika: Draft messages:
- "Conflicting rule detected. Adjust priority or conditions"
- "This rule will never match any request."
- "Circular fallback detected  please fix the chain."
Psalm: A11y: badge contrast is failing (2.7:1). Also add aria-live for diagnostics.
Kai: We'll bump badge contrast, add aria-live="assertive" for errors and polite for warnings, and keyboard reorder with aria-grabbed.
Maya: Preview UX: show sample request -> matched rule ID -> which condition matched -> final route. Toggle "Show matched condition".
Sam: When preview highlights a rule, focus that element (no auto-open edit panel). Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Anika: Tooltip copy: "Drag to reorder (higher priority on top)". Placeholder: "Add routing rule".
Jon: Add ?seed=1234 param to simulator so designers can reproduce traces.
Maya: For warnings show toast "Saved with warnings  view issues" and a "View warnings" link.
Sam: Action items: Anika update copy in Figma, Kai stub aria-live and keyboard reorder, Jon add seed support, Psalm confirm contrast. Back at 10:30 if blockers.
design-bot: @channel Comment by Anika: "Updated copy + added trace sample"
Sam: Thanks all. I'll freeze copy EOD.
